messages.subject: Project Ember — sale contract — our mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Our redline is attached. The main changes:
- completion at 15 working days rather than 20;
- service-charge retention reduced to £100,000, held as stakeholder, with a 5-working-day release on agreement of the reconciliation;
- TOGC fallback shortened to 5 working days with interest at the contract rate; and
- the s.198 election window extended to 60 working days.

All fairly standard. Happy to talk anything through.

James
